newsitem.title: JAPAN: Kobe rubber futures lower in after-hours trade.
newsitem.headline: Kobe rubber futures lower in after-hours trade.

text.p: Kobe rubber futures were weaker in an extremely thin after-hours session on Friday, as market players retreated to the sidelines ahead of the long weekend and the spot expiry next Tuesday, traders said.
Prices ranged from unchanged to 0.3 yen per kg lower than the day's close. Benchmark February was down 0.1 yen at 139.4 yen. Volume was 4,123 lots.

During the day, the market started mostly firmer, backed by the yen's weaker tone against the dollar. But prices failed to maintain early gains due to sporadic selling for position adjustment, the traders said.
